mesh_geometry: Actual learned S1 muscle world vertices at the same reference frame, from the validated raw fullbody cache.
distance_method: Native MuJoCo wrapped spatial tendon paths resampled to64 arc-length points using muscle_tubes.resample_path. Median mesh-vertex distance to path and mean path-point distance to mesh vertices; these are point-cloud distances, not surface or attachment errors.
ranking: spatial_score_mm=0.5*(mesh-to-path median + path-to-mesh mean). review_score_mm=spatial_score_mm-35 if a label alias/group candidate. All label candidates, top5 review candidates and top5 spatial candidates are retained. The35mm label prior is a review heuristic, not a validated likelihood.
review_warning: Proximity can confuse adjacent muscle heads, tendons, merged regions or nearby crossing paths. No review candidate is automatically certified or enabled.
subject: S1
review_status: All unreviewed; no correspondence approved or enabled
scope: Existing S1 rest-pose candidate ranking from the historical integration audit; not independent anatomy ground truth. Units are millimetres. Label-group weights are disabled review proposals.
